title: Sequential Digits
summary: Identify and list all integers within a given range [low, high] that have digits in consecutive ascending order, then sort the list.
statement: Identify and list all integers within a given range [low, high] that have digits in consecutive ascending order, then sort the list.
constraints: Every digit must be exactly one greater than its predecessor.
hints: All answers are contiguous slices of 123456789.
Enumerate slice lengths two through nine and every valid start.
Convert each slice and keep it when it lies in the inclusive range.
There are only 36 candidate slices, so exhaustive enumeration is constant-sized.
editorial: There are only 36 candidate slices, so exhaustive enumeration is constant-sized.

tests.explanation: The qualifying values are 1234 and 2345 through 6789 and 12345.
